body: Closes S170-105's third and final stage: 'add Adelle' -> lore -> game -> 'then the boys do a podcast with her' (redirected to Cain mid-pipeline). Same established podcast-transcript format as mid-piano-presents-the-new-guys (S170-95) -- TYLER moderating, Unicorn on text cards, Duck's running bit, garage setting -- this time a focused single-guest episode since the founder's promise was about one hero specifically. Every beat drawn from Cain's real lore and kit: the curse-and-mercy duality, founding the first city, his R (can't die, not invincible) and W (dashes away, cursed to wander) both explained through his actual ability design. Live at https://okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-mark/. OKEMILY cb9eeb7.
title: Blog: 'Mid-Piano Presents: The Mark' (Cain podcast) -- closes S170-105
